## What changed?

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Why?

What distinct problem does this solve?

## Validation

- [ ] I reviewed the changed source as public material.
- [ ] No secrets, private/internal identifiers, private infrastructure details, or credential-bearing URLs were added.
- [ ] The change does not duplicate an existing Skill's responsibility.
- [ ] Each changed Skill still has exactly one root `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] Helper behavior matches its documentation.
- [ ] Any helper network access, mutation, or privilege requirement is explicitly documented and necessary.
- [ ] Relevant tests/fixtures were added or updated.
- [ ] Relevant release documentation was added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_public_skills.py` passes.
- [ ] No generated bytecode, caches, archives, or hidden binary payloads were added.

## Release note

Do not invent a release hash or claim a GitHub release exists before a human publishes and verifies it.
